title: Von Braun passing secrets at the Mexican border

tellings.quote: I think there's some story of Warner von Braun, you know, um, giving off trade secrets at the border in Mexico or whatever.

related.note: Both say von Braun leaked secrets after the war, but they disagree on how and to whom.

plain: There is a story that the German rocket engineer Wernher von Braun handed over secret technical information at the border with Mexico, placed around 1945. Michels mentions it in passing during a talk with a guest named Peter Levenda, hedging that he thinks there is "some story" of this and naming no source. If true, it would mean one of the most important scientists brought to America was leaking its secrets.
